messages:
lina: Quick copy/a11y check for the actions menu tooltip (three-dot ellipsis). Current tooltip: "More". Feels vague. Figma: https://figma.redwood/actions-ellipsis (frame)
omar: Agree, "More" doesn't help keyboard or screen reader users. Options: "Actions", "More actions", or contextual like "Run, Edit, Delete"?
ben: Contextual might be too long. I like "More actions" because it indicates an action menu. Also recommend we add aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-label on the button to be explicit for SRs.
marc: For hover tooltips we show text on hover after 300ms. For keyboard focus we currently don't show the tooltip at all. That's bad. Tooltip should appear on focus too and be reachable by SRs via aria-label. Also watch duplicates: if the visible label is present, don't repeat in tooltip for SRs.
lina: Proposed microcopy: visible tooltip text = "More actions"; aria-label on button = "More actions. Opens actions menu"; aria-haspopup="menu"; aria-expanded toggles. That gives context to SRs.
omar: Small nit: avoid punctuation like periods in aria-label unless necessary. Maybe "More actions, opens menu" or "More actions; opens menu". We should test with VoiceOver.
ben: Also we should not rely only on tooltip for keyboard users. When focused, the button should announce via screen reader the aria-label. Tooltip is visual. Tooltip timing: respect prefers-reduced-motion and avoid long delays.
aria-bot: Accessibility checklist added to ticket #4589: include aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, explicit aria-label with context, tooltip visible on focus, respects reduced motion, voiceover tested. (auto-note)
lina: Final copy to lock: Tooltip (visual): "More actions". Button aria-label: "More actions, opens actions menu". Implementation notes: show tooltip on hover and focus (300ms delay), but override for reduced-motion to show immediately. Add a unit test asserting tooltip appears on keyboard focus.
marc: I'll implement and run VoiceOver. If it reads oddly we'll tweak to "Opens actions menu" first. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
